## Appearance

Anne is a pale girl with a thin figure, long legs, and a pointed, freckled face with a little pointed chin. She has big, solemn gray eyes, which are starrier than those of other girls, as well as delicate features. Though her hair is naturally red and often worn in long braids, it at times streams unbraided in a torrent of brightness, clusters in short silky curls, turns green after an incident, or lightens to auburn. Over time, her height increases until she is taller than [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## Personality

Characterized by an exceptionally vivid imagination, she frequently falls into daydreams and expresses herself in a talkative manner. This imaginative temperament contributes to an impulsive nature, where actions and words are executed without prior reflection. She possesses an intense emotional capacity, displaying passionate affection alongside a stubborn tenacity for holding grudges and a quick temper. Despite this fiery disposition, she is generous and demonstrates practical abilities, including rapid running speed, a talented singing voice, and a talent for writing compositions. She has also shown remarkable skill and composure when treating a sick child suffering from croup. Driven by strong ambitions, she aspires to excel academically, aiming to become a teacher, win a scholarship, and attend college, while harboring a specific fear of traversing the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after dark.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley spent her early childhood as an orphan, being shuffled between foster families—where she helped care for many children—and an overcrowded asylum in [Hopeton](../codex/places.md#hopeton). She was eventually adopted by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), though her initial arrival was met with surprise because they had requested a boy. Anne rapidly made [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) her home, swearing a deep friendship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and establishing a fierce academic rivalry with classmate [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after he rudely called her 'Carrots.' Over her early years in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Anne got into frequent scrapes, such as accidentally getting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk on currant wine, accidentally flavoring a cake with liniment for the new minister, and dyeing her hair green. Despite these mishaps, she proved her resourcefulness by nursing Diana's sister through croup, winning over Diana's formidable [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), and excelling under the tutelage of her teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Her hard work culminated in tying for first place on the entrance exams for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), where she subsequently won the prestigious Avery scholarship. However, following Matthew's sudden death from shock over a bank failure and Marilla's diagnosis of failing eyesight, Anne selflessly gave up her college scholarship to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She chose to teach locally instead, happily reconciling her long-standing rivalry with Gilbert after he gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school position for her.

## Quotes

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

> “I think he’s lovely,” said Anne reproachfully. “He is so very sympathetic. He didn’t mind how much I talked—he seemed to like it. I felt that he was a kindred spirit as soon as ever I saw him.”
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)

> "Oh, I don’t mean that sort of a name. I mean just a name you gave it yourself. Didn’t you give it a name? May I give it one then? May I call it—let me see—Bonny would do—may I call it Bonny while I’m here? Oh, do let me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P33](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0033)

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) is the minister's wife and a trusted confidante to Anne. Although their acquaintance began awkwardly when Anne accidentally ruined a cake meant for her, Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) showed immense kindness, forgiving the mistake and comforting her as a kindred spirit. They remain close friends, with Anne spending the evening with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) after receiving her exam results.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P29](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), +10 more_

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's closest friend and soulmate, with whom she swore a solemn oath of friendship shortly after meeting. Their bond has endured despite major obstacles, including a temporary separation enforced by Diana's mother after Anne accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) wine. Their closeness was firmly restored after Anne saved Diana's sister from croup, and they continue to share school life, social visits, and imaginative endeavors together.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Anne began as bitter academic rivals after Gilbert teased her by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting Anne to smash a slate over his head and refuse his apology. Despite his repeated attempts to make peace—including rescuing her from a stranded flatboat—Anne stubbornly held onto her grudge for years while maintaining an intense scholastic competition with him. They eventually reconciled, becoming fast friends as they pursued their studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy).

### [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) is Anne's foster father and one of her dearest, gentlest friends. From the moment they met, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) took a liking to Anne, quietly advocating for her to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and consistently offering her affection, treats, and soft-spoken encouragement.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), +10 more_

The Delights of Anticipation P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), +2 more</sub>

### [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

[Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) is [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's young sister, whose life Anne saved by nursing her through a severe night of croup using knowledge gained from her previous foster homes. This heroic act earned Anne the gratitude and forgiveness of the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) family.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), +1 more_

- Saved — saved Minnie May's life during illness  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and Anne got off to a turbulent start when Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) insulted Anne's looks and Anne responded with a fierce temper tantrum. After [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) persuaded Anne to offer a dramatic apology, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) readily forgave her, eventually growing to praise and admire Anne's dramatic character growth over the years.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), +6 more_
